acceptance_criteria: Ticket entity has optional sla_deadline datetime field
New CheckSLABreach use case returns list of tickets past SLA deadline
Existing CreateTicket and ResolveTicket use cases remain functional
API returns sla_deadline in Ticket responses when present
All existing tests continue to pass

attachments.ref: SLA deadline is calculated as created_at + tier-based SLA hours (standard=48h, premium=24h, enterprise=4h)

invariants.description: Existing tickets without sla_deadline must remain valid (nullable field)
invariants.name: existing_tickets_unaffected

invariants.description: Existing API endpoints must continue to work without sla_deadline
invariants.name: api_backward_compatible

invariants.description: No existing data can be modified or deleted by this change
invariants.name: no_data_loss

reason: Add SLA tracking capability to support service level compliance monitoring. Customers require visibility into whether tickets are being resolved within agreed timeframes.

risk.notes: Additive change only. No modifications to existing fields or logic. New field is nullable for backward compatibility.

scope.summary: Add sla_deadline field to Ticket entity and CheckSLABreach use case for SLA compliance monitoring
